firstPlayerRule: If a player is named Suzanne Sheldon, that player goes first. Otherwise, whoever most recently ate pie starts.
clarifications: The same opening rule applies to the two-player game; its listed changes do not change the starter.
For rounds two and three, the player with the lowest score starts. If tied, the tied player next in the previous round's turn order starts.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the English PDF directly from the Restoration Games product page and visually checked PDF pages 2 and 5. Setup names Suzanne Sheldon, otherwise the most recent pie eater. The later-round section awards the next start to the lowest scorer and breaks a tie by previous turn order. PDF page 6 lists two-player changes without changing the first-player rule. The publisher identifies its Berried Treasure restoration, matching inventory BGG 342073 rather than Sid Sackson's earlier Buried Treasure.
